_about: Data scripts/gen-graphics-lock.mjs carries into packages/core/src/motion/addonlock.ts besides the lock: the Chrome for Testing headless-shell zips (verified 2026-10-16: md5 against Google's x-goog-hash, then sha256), and each tarball's size by integrity (package-lock.json has none; a write takes a missing one from npm's local cache).
`accepted`: the add-on fingerprint (ADDON_LOCK_SHA256) and closure the drift guard compares with, and each zip's sha256; only --accept-addon-change writes it.
